title: Vial of gold flakes: 'It's all about the moon'

tellings.quote: forget about all this other stuff. It's all about the moon. He slams this little vial down. I pick it up. I look at it and I'm like and I shake it like it's a snow globe, but there's no liquid in it.

plain: In 1996, at the Los Angeles offices of Dark Skies, a project he worked on, a Hollywood writer named Brent Friedman says a man he calls "the captain" told him to "forget about all this other stuff. It's all about the moon," and slammed down a small vial. Friedman tells Michels that he picked it up and shook it like a snow globe, but there was no liquid in it, only flakes of gold. He tells it as something that happened to him, and the hint is that the moon holds a secret more important than anything else in the UFO story.
